csv_agency: State of California Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The Department hereby requests SOQs from qualified Proposers interested in entering a contract for preconstruction services, with the potential for continuing to a second contract for construction of all or part of the Work, for the South of Salinas Corridor Improvement Project (Project). The Project is located on Route 101, in the County of Monterey, from Main Street overcrossing in the town of Chualar at PM 76.55 to 0.56 miles south of Airport Blvd overcrossing in the City of Salinas at PM 85.04. Proposers interested in providing CMGC services, herein referred to as Construction Manager, will partner with the Department s design team on this Project.
